name: Support price adjustment policy example
answer: Customers can request a price adjustment within 14 days of purchase. Price adjustments are available for any competitor's lower price. Approved adjustments are refunded to the original payment method.

sources.title: Support Price Adjustment Policy
sources.content: Customers can request a price adjustment within 14 days of purchase. Price adjustments apply only when the lower price is from an approved retailer. Approved adjustments are refunded to the original payment method.
